function.name: mcp__ast-ts-refactor__find_references
function.description: Find every usage site of a TypeScript symbol (function, class, variable, or interface) across the whole project, including re-exports and barrel imports. Use to LOCATE where a symbol is referenced/used.

file.description: Optional — declaring file; auto-located if omitted

symbol.description: Symbol name to find usages of

function.name: mcp__ast-ts-refactor__rename_symbol
function.description: Rename a TypeScript symbol across the entire project, safely updating every reference so all usages stay in sync. Use to RENAME a function/class/variable/interface everywhere.

file.description: Optional — declaring file; auto-located if omitted

function.name: mcp__ast-ts-refactor__move_symbol
function.description: Move a TypeScript symbol from one file to another, rewriting the imports in all affected files. Use to RELOCATE a function/class/type to a different module/file.

source_file.description: File the symbol currently lives in

dest_file.description: File to move the symbol into

function.name: mcp__component-doc-gen__generate
function.description: Generate documentation (a props table, markdown docs, and optionally a Storybook story) for a SINGLE React component file.

component_path.description: Absolute path to the component .tsx, OR a component name / workspace-relative path (searched if not an existing file)

function.name: mcp__component-doc-gen__generate_batch
function.description: Generate documentation for EVERY React component matching a glob under a directory (bulk). Returns one doc per component file. Use for a whole folder of components, not a single file.

dir_path.description: Absolute path to a directory of components

function.name: mcp__a11y-audit__audit_file
function.description: Run an accessibility (axe-core) audit on a LOCAL HTML or React component file path and return WCAG violations.

html_or_component_path.description: Absolute path to a local .html or component file

rules.description: Optional axe rule IDs to restrict the run

function.name: mcp__a11y-audit__audit_url
function.description: Run an accessibility (axe-core) audit on a running URL (e.g. a dev server at http(s)://...) and return WCAG violations.

rules.description: Optional axe rule IDs to restrict the run

function.name: mcp__a11y-audit__list_rules
function.description: List every available axe accessibility rule ID with its description and WCAG level (A / AA / AAA). Use to DISCOVER which rules exist — does NOT audit anything.
